description: Every atom read in the macro front end allocates a fresh String from the runtime atom table; surface_head_name and atom_head_name allocate another per head. The atom table holds Arc<str>; readers get a shared AtomName. Spike (base 72c22569b, release instructions on distinct1/f761/f765/r6/lit16): atom_name -6.40/-3.03/-3.27/-11.86/-8.74%, allocation calls -16.4% on distinct1 (2,956,477 -> 2,472,805); head_name_shared on top -0.30/-0.12/-0.12/-1.39/-0.80%. About 14 files, mechanical. Not in scope and to be reported, not built: Module.atom_names as Vec<Arc<str>> (the macro-run atom table copy at backend.rs, 96k allocations, about 8 files). Spike diffs (port by reading): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/small/cand_atom_name.diff, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/small/cand_head_name_shared_with_atom_name.diff; numbers in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/small/results.md. Acceptance: stdout (interp and run), canonical dump, activation key counts and job counts identical to the base binary on /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/p/distinct1.fz, f761.fz (--top 1 --top 2), f765.fz (--max-top 3), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/m/r6.fz, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/l/lit16.fz; release instructions retired and allocation calls re-measured on base and change binaries built the same way; full gate; no pin, golden or census movement.
